brief.motion: 300-500ms duration, ease-out easing, staggered fade and short slide reveals
brief.layout: 1920x1080 canvas. Logo fixed in top-right corner. Headline centered or left-aligned with generous margins. Supporting points listed below headline with small source chips. Final scene centers logo, CTA button, and URL.
notes: Use Noto Sans JP for all Japanese text; ensure no Japanese words break across lines.
Include source chips for each supporting point using the provided sourced facts (e.g., GPUSOROBAN, Sakura Internet, Highreso).
Maintain calm, precise motion: no bouncing, no exaggerated effects, only fades and short slides.
Ensure the logo is visible in a corner on every scene and the final scene ends with logo, CTA, and URL.
Apply brand colors strictly: background #141414, primary text #fafafa, accent #10e80c for highlights.
Keep information density high: headline plus 2-3 supporting points per scene with source chips.
